Please don't decide anything about Rocky right now. Not while everything you own is in garbage bags and you haven't slept. Give it a few weeks on a couch with a cat in your face first, and if you still want to go after that, fine. But not like this.

Also, your songs are the best thing about our band. You can't quit. The notebooks are pulp but you wrote the songs, so they're not gone, and we'll help you get them back down.

You drove out to Gatton at 2am when my car carked it after Toowoomba and never once complained. Let me return the favour. What time suits tomorrow?
